# OakAttest

> Hosted security-assessment platform for IRAP assessor firms, MSPs, and the client organisations they assess. Scoping to certification, across every framework.

OakAttest is a hosted, invite-based workspace for running security assessments end to end: organisation setup, scoping, evidence collection, fieldwork, findings, residual risk, certification records, exportable artefacts, and ongoing compliance maintenance. It supports the Australian Government ISM (with Essential Eight and Cloud IRAP), NIST SP 800-53, SOC 2, and ISO/IEC 27001.

## Core Topics

- Security assessment platform for assessor firms and MSPs
- Multi-framework: ISM, NIST 800-53, SOC 2, ISO 27001
- IRAP assessment lifecycle, scoping to certification
- MSP multi-tenant: one instance, many MSPs, many client tenants
- Evidence chain of custody, findings, residual risk
- Internal collaboration: discussion threads, @mentions, notifications
- Defensible certification records and exportable artefacts
- Australian data residency and append-only audit

## Primary Users

ASD-registered IRAP assessor firms, managed service providers (MSPs) onboarding and managing client organisations, and the client organisations being assessed.

- [Platform](https://oak-attest.com/platform.html): Hosting, data residency, auditability, roles and access.

## Contact

Request access: hello@oak-attest.com

OakAttest is a hosted, proprietary product. It is delivered as a managed service with invite-based access; deployments declare data residency and keep an append-only audit trail.
